summary: Focana 1.7.3 tightens the handoff back into work after saving a session or moving into floating mode.
fixes: Saving a resumed task for later now takes you straight to the What's next? screen so you can choose the next focus without seeing the resume prompt again.
Manually minimizing Focana to floating mode now stays quiet instead of immediately opening an overdue What's next? or Ready to resume? prompt.

summary: Focana 1.7.2 makes wake, pause, and next-task flows calmer and more reliable.
fixes: Focana now waits longer before opening the resume prompt after your Mac wakes.
The What's next? screen now fits properly, including the Next button.
Resume prompts no longer pulse right away when they appear.
Timer-end prompts no longer pulse unnecessarily as the timer finishes.
Pausing a session now shows clearer paused-session language.
Done for now is now Save and continue later, making it clearer that your task will be waiting when you come back.
Saving a paused session for later now keeps it available to resume reliably.

summary: Focana 1.7.1 is a stability hotfix for the 1.7 release, focused on making wake, pause, and floating-mode handoffs feel dependable again.
fixes: Fixed a macOS window issue that could make Focana close unexpectedly during floating or Session Wrap handoffs.
Fixed the Done for now path from Pause so Focana reliably returns to the floating icon instead of disappearing from view.
Fixed wake re-entry timing so Focana opens the return-to-work prompt promptly after your Mac wakes.
Improved packaged smoke coverage for pause, floating, and wake-related handoffs so these flows are checked before release.

summary: Focana 1.7.0 makes returning to work more deliberate, with smarter re-entry after interruptions, a clearer app-managed trial and upgrade path, and a more useful pause flow that can wrap, resume, or save the active session.
improvements: Added an auto re-entry rule so interrupted work can come back in the right surface without asking you to rebuild context from scratch.
Added an app-managed trial and upgrade flow that makes activation, upgrade prompts, and packaged release behavior clearer.
Improved resident app flows so relaunching, waking, quitting, and returning from compact or floating mode preserve focus more intentionally.
Pause now opens a dismissible Session Wrap, letting you keep working, mark the task complete, take a break, start something new, or save the paused session for later.
fixes: Fixed direct completion and wake re-entry paths so saved work and next-step prompts stay aligned after interruptions.
Fixed compact quit behavior and startup window selection edge cases that could leave Focana in the wrong surface.
Improved shortcut and check-in focus handling so temporary global actions return attention to the right place.
Added release safeguards for analytics configuration and expanded packaged-flow coverage around floating, compact, and pause session states.

summary: Focana 1.6.0 makes startup and quitting more intentional, with launch at login, clearer resume behavior, and safer ways to keep the app resident instead of accidentally closing it.
improvements: Added Launch at login in Settings so Focana can open automatically when you sign in.
Startup now uses a clearer set of surfaces: clean starts open the normal idle window, while interrupted or resumable work comes back in clearer resume states.
Quit confirmation now offers Cancel, Minimize, Hide, and Quit so it is easier to keep Focana resident instead of accidentally shutting it down.
fixes: Restoring from floating minimize now more reliably returns to the correct window state instead of surfacing stale hidden-window state.
Sleep, relaunch, and update restart flows now preserve interrupted work more consistently across startup and resume.
Release tooling now finds shared .env.release files from the main checkout when you run ship flows from a fresh worktree.

summary: Focana makes the return-to-work flow feel tighter in 1.5.1, with a cleaner resume prompt and a faster way to close out saved work before moving on.
improvements: Resume prompts now use a tighter layout in both full and compact windows, with copy and spacing that keep the key actions visible more consistently.
The re-entry chooser now labels the active task more clearly so it is easier to confirm what you are picking back up.
fixes: If you choose Start Something New from a resumable prompt, you can now mark the saved task complete with recap and next steps instead of being forced to keep it open.
Resume and save-for-later surfaces now size more reliably so notes fields and controls are less likely to feel cramped.

summary: Focana now gives you a cleaner handoff at the end of a session, whether you want a break, another focused block, or a fresh start.
improvements: Session Wrap now offers clearer next steps: Take a break, Keep working, Start a new task, or Done for now.
Keep working now supports a faster timed restart flow, including Enter-to-start from the post-session timer field.
Break mode now lets you choose whether minimizing shows the countdown timer, with quicker click behavior for returning to work.
Idle nudges now ask “What’s next?” and keep Session History and Parking Lot easy to reach from the re-entry prompt.
fixes: Timed sessions now hand off directly into Session Wrap instead of getting stranded at 00:00 or falling into a separate timeout modal.
Post-session notes and follow-up screens now size more reliably so actions and text fields stay visible.
Break-time floating interactions now behave more predictably whether the countdown is hidden or shown.

summary: Focana now helps you maintain momentum after a session ends and resume work with less friction.
improvements: Ending a session now opens a guided post-session flow with Take a break, Start another session, and Done for now.
Session notes are now split into Immediate next step and Additional details so restart cues stay separate from background context.
Starting another session after a wrap-up now drops you into a clean composer with Parking Lot and Session History close by.
Keep for Later is now available as a global shortcut with Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+K for quick Parking Lot capture.
Focused check-ins now support Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Y for a quick Yes response when Focana is frontmost.
fixes: Floating re-entry prompts now stay in the floating flow more reliably instead of unexpectedly restoring the main window.
Save for Later, break, and done-for-now handoffs now preserve task continuity more reliably across full, compact, and floating windows.
The new post-session and notes screens now size more cleanly so actions and text fields stay visible.

summary: Focana now does a better job helping you re-enter work with intention instead of drifting back in automatically.
improvements: Idle prompts now guide you back into focus across full, compact, and floating modes.
Resumable tasks now offer clearer choices to resume or start something new.
Floating prompts now resize more cleanly and keep key actions visible.
Snooze options are now more explicit and intentional.
fixes: Save for Later notes now save more reliably.
Prompt and window-state handoffs between full, compact, and floating modes are more stable.
Time's up and resume-later flows now preserve task state more reliably.

summary: Small fixes, smoother focus sessions, and a cleaner release notes home for keeping up with what ships next.
improvements: You can move completed or discarded sessions back to Resume.
Switching tasks from Parking Lot during an active session is now smoother.
Parking Lot delete and clear actions are now safer.
Full-window dragging feels more reliable.
fixes: Sessions now pause when your Mac sleeps.
Timers over an hour are now easier to read.
